rationale: The agent performed multiple order-changing write actions (returns and modifications) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy. Specifically, it executed return_delivered_order_items twice and modified a pending order’s address and items without any confirmation step. The agent also did not provide the requested tracking number for the cancelled order (no tool call for tracking and no final info shared). Authentication appears minimal (email lookup and user details retrieval) with no explicit verification dialogue. Finally, the closing message is a generic sign-off and does not report results or confirmations. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
